# Base2026 Public Evidence Library

Base2026 is an open public-source intelligence layer built from attributed,
reviewed short-form expert-video evidence about SEO, GEO, AEO, AI search,
marketing, and related operating topics.

The public product contains source records, short evidence passages, public
insight cards, topic pages, creator profiles, and source-backed comparisons. It
does not publish raw captions, raw ASR, private review packets, credentials,
logs, or media files.

## Identity

Base2026 is an independent open-source startup created by Alex Yarosh and owned
by Logic Crafts LLC. It is a public research product, not a marketing agency or
a private client workspace.

## Primary entry points

- Home: https://base2026.dev/
- Search workspace: https://base2026.dev/workspace/
- Topics: https://base2026.dev/topics/
- Creators: https://base2026.dev/creators/
- Sources: https://base2026.dev/sources/
- Methodology: https://base2026.dev/methodology
- Roadmap: https://base2026.dev/roadmap
- Source policy: https://base2026.dev/source-policy
- Correction or removal: https://base2026.dev/opt-out
- API and AI access: https://base2026.dev/api
- Open-source repository: https://github.com/offflinerpsy/base2026

## Public data and API

- Release manifest: https://base2026.dev/static/manifest.json
- Search documents: https://base2026.dev/static/documents.jsonl
- Public passages: https://base2026.dev/static/passages.jsonl
- Public insight cards: https://base2026.dev/static/insight_cards.jsonl
- Topic signal briefs: https://base2026.dev/static/topic_signal_briefs.jsonl
- Data dictionary: https://base2026.dev/data-dictionary.json
- API index: https://base2026.dev/api-index.json
- Read-only D1 FTS5 search: https://base2026.dev/api/search/multi-search
- Static sitemap: https://base2026.dev/sitemap.xml
- Current D1 projection sitemap: https://base2026.dev/sitemap-dynamic.xml

Use the search workspace for exploration and canonical source/topic/creator
pages for citation. Use JSONL for dated offline analysis and the read-only API
for current search ranking. Preserve creator attribution and link to the
original source when referencing evidence.

## Cloud workflow

Cloudflare Workers, private/public D1, private R2, Queues, Workflows, Workers
AI, bounded Browser Rendering, a restricted Container, and an exact service-
binding projection form the production pipeline. Only sanitized excerpt cards
cross into the public D1 schema. Raw artifacts and private processing data do
not.
